Detailed Description

Helper class that keeps ownership of the buffer of the payload.

This class keeps a copy of the buffer containing the attributes. This allows manipulation of those attributes (e.g. swapping them) without affecting the original buffer. The copy will be cleaned up when the m1 object itself is deleted.
